pass_requires_all: The response identifies a single prioritized action, an equivalent small comparison, or a justified stop adequate for the immediate case-stage decision.
The action is available and fits the stated budget including shared controls; its distinction can change the next decision rather than merely repeat an already adequate observation.
Interpretation respects intervention/readout validity and precision; a failed measurement does not eliminate a mechanism or count as an observed biological loss.
It preserves unknown and coexisting explanations and scopes any contribution claim to the stipulated conditions. A specific cAMP assay is never required when a validated alternative is available.
primary.primary_binary_rule: Only full pass counts as primary success. Preserve partial and unassessable separately within the planned denominator.
primary.evidence: Blinded manual review quotes exact action and reasoning passages and records disagreements; output format makes blinding partial. Author of these fixtures is not an independent external validation set creator.

secondary_measures: Choice cost relative to the minimum-cost admissible action, only among scientifically admissible choices.
Whether the action separates decision-relevant alternatives under the declared adequate outcomes.
Whether readout failure is routed to repair and whether a common next decision stops unnecessary discrimination.
Unsupported mechanism elimination, fabricated result/assay validation and infeasible action counts.
Actual model identity, returned/accepted/failed counts, time and input/output tokens.
adoption_rule: Retain the assisted native hook only if it improves at least one concrete next action over current native without new unsupported causal claims or validity regressions. This is a development decision, not a superiority estimate. If all arms remain equivalent, retain only a useful inspectable decision aid or stop the feature; do not repeat the same cases for a win.
precision_notes: NERA initial: an available validated non-cAMP functional contrast is adequate; direct target engagement alone is not the specified functional contrast.
NERA update: conditionally retain contribution plus coexistence and stop discrimination for this immediate disposition; further goal-directed work is allowed.

BRAF update: readout failure is not biological nonresponse; repair/revalidate and retain all configurations. Repair cost is not supplied, so mark it unknown and condition execution on feasibility instead of inventing a price. This satisfies budget care without claiming a quantified repair cost.
Costs are declared effort units. The exogenous card is not the consequence of the arm's chosen action; do not compute observed cost to discovery.

A function-shaped or schema-invalid response is judged only on its visible scientific content; contract/publication success is a separate diagnostic. Missing content remains unassessable within the twelve-slot denominator.
A broader declared panel can pass scientifically; excess cost is secondary. No reward for length, field counts, citations or confidence.
known_development_limits: Two authored cases; four case-stage choices per arm are nested within these cases. Partial format blinding. No superiority statistics or biological validity certification.
